title: V2TokenResponse
description: Token response for v2 endpoints (uses snake_case field names)

access_token.description: Short lived Bearer JWT token to access APIs

refresh_token.description: Long lived token used to refresh access token

sso_token.description: Single Sign-On token for session management

token_type.description: Type of token. Only supports Bearer for now

expires_in.description: Expiry of the access token in seconds

is_new_user.description: Indicates if the user is new
